# COI
Choosed marker: COI_MW_Cfar - MW729433 from Russia 

## Obtain the sequences of COI for Crepidostomum from GeneBank 
```{bash, collapse=TRUE}
# From ENA:
if [ ! -d Genbank ]; then mkdir Genbank; fi
if [ ! -e Genbank/CrepiCoxENA.fa ]; then
   if [ ! -e Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt ]; then
   ## COI
      PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
      RESULT="result=sequence&"
      QUERY="query=tax_tree(334452)%20AND%20description%3D%22coi%22&"
      FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name%2Chost%2Ccountry%2Ctax_id&"
      FORMAT="format=tsv"
      curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT >> Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt
   ## COX1
      PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
      RESULT="result=sequence&"
      QUERY="query=tax_tree(334452)%20AND%20description%3D%22cox1%22&"
      FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name%2Chost%2Ccountry%2Ctax_id&"
      FORMAT="format=tsv"
      curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT | tail -n +2 >> Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt
      # if I do Coi and Cox1 at the same time add this | tail -n +2 
   fi
   BROWSER="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/fasta/"
   cut -f 1 Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt | tail -n +2 > Genbank/accessions.txt
   ACCESSIONS=$(gawk -v ORS="," '{print}' Genbank/accessions.txt |  sed 's/.$//' )
   curl -s $BROWSER$ACCESSIONS > Genbank/CrepiCoxENA.fa
fi
```

## Edit and selecting the sequences of GenBank
```{r, collapse = TRUE, warning=FALSE}
suppressWarnings(library('DECIPHER'))
suppressWarnings(library('htmltools'))
suppressWarnings(library('stringr'))

## Edit the sequences of GenBank
CrepiCoxENA <- readDNAStringSet("Genbank/CrepiCoxENA.fa")

## Adding the information 
if (!file.exists("GenBank_farionis.fa")) {
  info <- read.delim("Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt", header = TRUE)
  rownames(info) <- info$accession
  for (i in 1:length(names(CrepiCoxENA))) {
    name <- paste0("C.", strsplit(names(CrepiCoxENA), " ")[[i]][3])
    accession <- strsplit(names(CrepiCoxENA), "\\|")[[i]][2]
    #host <- paste0(strsplit(info[accession, 3], " ")[[1]][1], "_", strsplit(info[accession, 3], " ")[[1]][2])
    country <- str_to_upper(substr(info[accession, 4], 1,2))
    names(CrepiCoxENA)[i] <- paste0(accession, "_", name, "_", country)
  }
  writeXStringSet(CrepiCoxENA[names(CrepiCoxENA)[grep(".farionis", names(CrepiCoxENA), fixed = TRUE)]], "GenBank_COI_farionis.fa")
}

```

## Download the outgroups
```{r, collapse = TRUE, warning=FALSE}
## Keep only two sequences as outgroups (the most complete)
## Isa has some sequences that can be outgroups too. 
writeXStringSet(CrepiCoxENA[names(CrepiCoxENA)[grep("metoecus", names(CrepiCoxENA), fixed = TRUE)[c(1,2)]]], "Outgroups.fa")
```

Choosed marker: COI_MW_Cfar - MW729433 from Russia 
```{r, collapse=TRUE}

RefGen_COI <- readDNAStringSet("../2023-10-02/markers/COI_MW_Cfar.fa")
GB_far <- readDNAStringSet("GenBank_COI_farionis.fa")

## Sequences sent by Isabel (all Crepidostomum sp.)
Extra_Cox1 <- readDNAStringSet("../../data/SeqCox1_Crepido_spp_Isabel.fa")
Extra2_Cox1 <- readDNAStringSet("../../data/SeqCox1_Crepido_spp_Kristine.fas")
## Outgroups 
Outgroup <-  readDNAStringSet("Outgroups.fa")

## Our samples 
CrepiCOI <- readDNAStringSet("../2023-10-02/GB/COI_MW_Cfar_align.fa-gb1")
CrepiCOI <- CrepiCOI[names(CrepiCOI)[-grep("S031Cmc", names(CrepiCOI))]]# without data

AllSequences_TreeR <- c(RefGen_COI, GB_far, CrepiCOI, Extra_Cox1, Extra2_Cox1)
## Removing gaps 
AllSeq_Tree_Ngaps <- DNAStringSet(chartr("-", "N", as.character(AllSequences_TreeR)))

BrowseSeqs(AlignSeqs(AllSeq_Tree_Ngaps))

writeXStringSet(AllSequences_TreeR, "AllSeq_Tree.fa")
#writeXStringSet(Aligned_SeqTree, "Aligned_AllSeqTree.fa")
```

```{bash, collapse = TRUE}
FOLDER=RAxML/COI_round01
## "Probably most accurate L-INS-i
if [ ! -d RAxML ]; then mkdir RAxML; fi
if [ ! -d $FOLDER ]; then mkdir $FOLDER; fi
if [ ! -e $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg ]; then
  mafft --maxiterate 1000 --thread 24 --localpair AllSeq_Tree.fa > $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg
fi
```

### Trimm the alignment

```{bash}
Gblocks RAxML/COI_round01/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg -t=d -b1=65 -b2=92 -b4=10 -e=-gb1 -d=y -v=1500 -b3=50 -b5=h
```

```{r, collapse = TRUE}
#if (file.exists("RAxML/COI_round01/AlignTree_Mafft.alg") == FALSE) {
  Align <- readDNAStringSet("RAxML/COI_round01/AlignTree_Mafft_01.alg-gb1")
  #BrowseSeqs(Align)
  Freq <- alphabetFrequency(Align)
  #Remove from the alignment those seq with more than 75% of gaps + N
  Freq <- which((Freq[,15] + Freq[,16]) > (length(Align[[1]]) * 0.25))
  Align <- Align[-Freq]
  writeXStringSet(Align, "RAxML/COI_round01/AlignTree_Mafft.alg")
#}
```

```{bash, collapse = TRUE}
FOLDER=RAxML/COI_round01
## Finally run a tree Search
raxml-ng --msa $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg --model GTR+G --prefix $FOLDER/T2 --threads 48
 
## Compute and map bootstrap support values to the best ML tree (S1.raxml.bestTree)
raxml-ng --bootstrap --msa $FOLDER/AlignTree_Mafft.alg --model GTR+G --prefix $FOLDER/S2_bestTree --tree $FOLDER/T2.raxml.bestTree --threads 48 --bs-trees 10000

# Recompute support values using the Transfer Bootstrap Expectation (TBE) algorithm. Did this change the support values?
raxml-ng --support --tree $FOLDER/T2.raxml.bestTree --bs-trees $FOLDER/S2_bestTree.raxml.bootstraps --prefix $FOLDER/S2_FBP --threads 48 --bs-metric fbp
raxml-ng --support --tree $FOLDER/T2.raxml.bestTree --bs-trees $FOLDER/S2_bestTree.raxml.bootstraps --prefix $FOLDER/S2_TBE --threads 48 --bs-metric tbe 

```

## Obtain the sequences of COI for Crepidostomum from GeneBank 
```{bash, collapse=TRUE}
# From ENA:
if [ ! -d Genbank ]; then mkdir Genbank; fi
if [ ! -e Genbank/CrepiCox28S.fa ]; then
   if [ ! -e Genbank/INFO_28S_accessions.txt ]; then
   ## large subunit ribosomal
      PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
      RESULT="result=sequence&"
      QUERY="query=tax_tree(334452)%20AND%20description%3D%22large%20subunit%20ribosomal%20%22&"
      FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name%2Chost%2Ccountry%2Ctax_id&"
      FORMAT="format=tsv"
      curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT >> Genbank/INFO_28S_accessions.txt
   ## 28S
      PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
      RESULT="result=sequence&"
      QUERY="query=tax_tree(334452)%20AND%20description%3D%2228S%22&"
      FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name%2Chost%2Ccountry%2Ctax_id&"
      FORMAT="format=tsv"
      curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT | tail -n +2 >> Genbank/INFO_28S_accessions.txt
      # if I do Coi and Cox1 at the same time add this | tail -n +2 
   fi
   BROWSER="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/fasta/"
   cut -f 1 Genbank/INFO_28S_accessions.txt | tail -n +2 > Genbank/accessions_28S.txt
   ACCESSIONS=$(gawk -v ORS="," '{print}' Genbank/accessions_28S.txt |  sed 's/.$//' )
   curl -s $BROWSER$ACCESSIONS > Genbank/CrepiCox28S.fa
fi
```

## Edit and selecting the sequences of GenBank
```{r, collapse = TRUE, warning=FALSE}
suppressWarnings(library('DECIPHER'))
suppressWarnings(library('htmltools'))
suppressWarnings(library('stringr'))

## Edit the sequences of GenBank
CrepiCox28S <- readDNAStringSet("Genbank/CrepiCox28S.fa")

## Adding the information 
if (!file.exists("GenBank_28S_farionis.fa")) {
  info <- read.delim("Genbank/INFO_28S_accessions.txt", header = TRUE)
  rownames(info) <- info$accession
  for (i in 1:length(names(CrepiCox28S))) {
    name <- paste0("C.", strsplit(names(CrepiCox28S), " ")[[i]][3])
    accession <- strsplit(names(CrepiCox28S), "\\|")[[i]][2]
    #host <- paste0(strsplit(info[accession, 3], " ")[[1]][1], "_", strsplit(info[accession, 3], " ")[[1]][2])
    country <- str_to_upper(substr(info[accession, 4], 1,2))
    names(CrepiCox28S)[i] <- paste0(accession, "_", name, "_", country)
  }
  writeXStringSet(CrepiCox28S[names(CrepiCox28S)[grep(".farionis", names(CrepiCox28S), fixed = TRUE)]][c(1,5,10,15)], "GenBank_28S_farionis.fa")
  writeXStringSet(CrepiCox28S[names(CrepiCox28S)[grep(".pseudofarionis", names(CrepiCox28S), fixed = TRUE)]], "GenBank_28S_pseudofarionis.fa")
}
```

## Obtain the sequences of ITS2 for Crepidostomum from GeneBank 
```{bash, collapse=TRUE}
# From ENA:
if [ ! -d Genbank ]; then mkdir Genbank; fi
if [ ! -e Genbank/CrepiITS2ENA.fa ]; then
   if [ ! -e Genbank/INFO_accessionsITS.txt ]; then
   ## ITS2
      PORTAL="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/portal/api/search?"
      RESULT="result=sequence&"
      QUERY="query=tax_tree(334452)%20AND%20description%3D%22internal%20transcribed%20spacer%202%2C%20complete%22&"
      FIELDS="fields=accession%2Cscientific_name%2Chost%2Ccountry%2Ctax_id&"
      FORMAT="format=tsv"
      curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT >> Genbank/INFO_accessionsITS.txt
      # if I do Coi and Cox1 at the same time add this | tail -n +2 
      #curl -s $PORTAL$RESULT$QUERY$FIELDS$FORMAT | tail -n +2 >> Genbank/INFO_accessions.txt
   fi
   BROWSER="https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/fasta/"
   cut -f 1 Genbank/INFO_accessionsITS.txt | tail -n +2 > Genbank/accessionsITS.txt
   ACCESSIONS=$(gawk -v ORS="," '{print}' Genbank/accessionsITS.txt |  sed 's/.$//' )
   curl -s $BROWSER$ACCESSIONS > Genbank/CrepiITS2ENA.fa
fi

# From NCBI: the sequences in the description study of C. pse 
# are missing, so we download it manually from Genbank. 
```

## Edit and selecting the sequences of GenBank
```{r, collapse = TRUE, warning=FALSE}
suppressWarnings(library('DECIPHER'))
suppressWarnings(library('htmltools'))
suppressWarnings(library('stringr'))

## Edit the sequences of GenBank
CrepiITS2ENA <- c(readDNAStringSet("Genbank/Cfarionis_ITS2.fasta"), readDNAStringSet("Genbank/Cpseudofarionis_ITS.fasta"))
CrepiITS2ENA2 <- readDNAStringSet("Genbank/CrepiITS2ENA.fa")
## Adding the information 
if (!file.exists("GenBank_ITS2_Crep.fa")) {
  info <- read.delim("Genbank/INFO_accessionsITS.txt", header = TRUE)
  rownames(info) <- info$accession
  for (i in 1:length(names(CrepiITS2ENA2))) {
    name <- paste0("C.", strsplit(names(CrepiITS2ENA2), " ")[[i]][3])
    accession <- strsplit(names(CrepiITS2ENA2), "\\|")[[i]][2]
    #host <- paste0(strsplit(info[accession, 3], " ")[[1]][1], "_", strsplit(info[accession, 3], " ")[[1]][2])
    country <- str_to_upper(substr(info[accession, 4], 1,2))
    names(CrepiITS2ENA2)[i] <- paste0(accession, "_", name, "_", country)
  }
  
  for (i in 1:length(names(CrepiITS2ENA))) {
    name <- paste0("C.", strsplit(names(CrepiITS2ENA), " ")[[i]][3])
    accession <- strsplit(strsplit(names(CrepiITS2ENA), " ")[[i]][1], "\\.1")[1]
    #host <- paste0(strsplit(info[accession, 3], " ")[[1]][1], "_", strsplit(info[accession, 3], " ")[[1]][2])
    country <- "IC/RU"
    names(CrepiITS2ENA)[i] <- paste0(accession, "_", name, "_", country)
  }
  
  CrepiITS2 <- c(CrepiITS2ENA2[names(CrepiITS2ENA2)[-grep(".sp.", names(CrepiITS2ENA2), fixed = TRUE)]], CrepiITS2ENA)
  writeXStringSet(CrepiITS2, "GenBank_ITS2_Crep.fa")
}


```

## Download the outgroups

# Missing data of the alignments
